name: Ramen Nagi
notes: Confirmed this is the Ramen Nagi USA chain location at 4301 La Jolla Village Dr Ste 2033, San Diego, CA 92122 (Westfield UTC food hall) -- matches the stored UTC location. No priced menu exists anywhere: the restaurant's own site (ramennagiusa.com) lists ramen flavor descriptions (Original/Red/Black/Green/Veggie King, Limited King specials, extras like Karaage Chicken, Snack Gyoza, Chashu Rice, Edamame) but no prices at all -- it's an info/marketing site, not an ordering page, and appears to have been hit with unrelated spam-SEO injected text (foreign-language gambling site links) unrelated to the restaurant. Ramen Nagi confirmed via a recent Facebook post that they take no online orders, only phone/in-person. Not listed on DoorDash or Uber Eats (checked via site-restricted search) -- consistent with a mall food-hall counter with no delivery. Yelp and Google Maps business listings show no priced menu (only 'popular dish' name tags with no $ amounts). The only prices found anywhere were in a single Instagram post ~2 years old (Original King $13.95, Red King $14.95) -- too stale to trust for 2026 pricing and too thin to build a menu around, so no dishes are recorded rather than guessing. Known menu structure for reference: ramen bases are Original King (tonkotsu pork broth), Red King (spicy garlic/chili/cayenne), Black King (garlic + calamari ink), Green King (basil/olive oil/parmesan), Veggie King (mushroom-cauliflower vegetarian), plus rotating Limited King specials; extras include Karaage Chicken, Snack Gyoza, Chashu Rice, Edamame.
